newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel, zinc gains -- other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel, zinc gains -- other metals steady.

text.p: Indian nickel, zinc and aluminium prices gained on Monday while other base metals were steady in a narrow price band, dealers said.
Nickel prices rose by 100 rupees to 36,600 rupees per quintal as a world market rally prompted speculative buying, while physical demand remained slow.
Nickel was up by 400 rupees per quintal on Saturday. Zinc bounced back by 50 rupees at 7,850 rupees per quintal on industrial buying after the market gained 50 rupees on Saturday.

Aluminium gained by 50 rupees at 7,500 rupees on expectations that local producers may hike prices in view of world market gains. Copper was steady at 13,500 rupees after gaining 50 rupees on Saturday and tin was quiet at 31,100 rupees per quintal after losing 100 rupees on Saturday.

Lead reamained steady at the reduced level of 4,150 rupees per quintal on eased pressure of arrivals following lower offering by the state-owned producers. Lead was down by 200 rupees per quintal last week.
